Long bodies stated at structure level per rule 5: 0085F020, 0085F980, 00860070, 00860E90, 0087F410 - these are the doubts most worth a second read. Specific doubts: 0085E3B0 - the stack vector A is the 0085E270-style product of (0, ck, -sk, w) with (P, 0, 0, 0); the listing omits the w*0 term in the fourth component and computes the 'zero' components as k*0.0, so the stated components are exact only for finite values. 0085F980 - [rbp+0x6F] is the entry rdx home slot (D) and [rbp+0x7F] the fourth home slot used as the local n; the fill value for the 16-byte buffers is a stack slot whose upper half is never written in this body, so it is not described. 0087F410 - the byte passed to the sort call at +0x90 is the low byte of r8's home slot ([rsp+0xB0] after the prologue), and the same slot is later read as a qword (r8 itself) for the body array. 00880020 (pack m1-15) has the same pattern. 00860B70 - the fifth/sixth stack arguments are [rsp+0xA0]/[rsp+0xA8] after a 0x78-byte prologue. 00860E90 - 'facing V[v] by more than 0.01e' means normal(00860720) . (V[v] - V[t0]) > 0.01*e, 'vertex mean' is 0.25 times the sum of V[p0..p3]; the backward scan stops at the first non-null triangle not containing v and restarts from the end after each extrude call.
